title: VoltPilot additional measurement apply acknowledgement
x-identity-rule: The three topic identity segments MUST byte-equal the payload identity fields.
x-rejection-entity-rule: Additive, AP-07 IP-18b: entity_id appears ONLY on a rejection of a SHARED POINT - the plan (mqtt-measurement-config x-point-key-rule, sent only to a box reporting measurement_config_per_component) named that point_key once per component. It names the refused component; the point_key may then ALSO stand in accepted, because the box reads it for its other components. A (point_key, entity_id) pair is refused at most once, and a rejection without entity_id (the whole point) never stands beside one with it. Every status of a plan without a shared point is byte for byte the one before: no entity_id. The edge core enforces this rule in WrapStatus (edge-app/core/internal/measurements).
x-reason-binding-unavailable: Geraeteseite Stufe 3c: the selection named a component (entity_id) the edge cannot resolve to a device it reads - unknown component, a pin naming a source this box does not publish (a removed source, or the core-owned Shelly transport that never reaches Node-RED), or a component without a pin that is not one of the platform-composed types. The point is NOT read; reading it over the primary inverter would produce a wrong value on a right-looking point. It is self-healing: the edge re-applies the plan whenever the registry or the source list changes, so a later push publishes a corrected status.
